teaching_note: A search index is a selected, delayed representation of records, not the underlying service and not permission to inspect it. Compare only instructor-supplied result snapshots: absence can mean indexing, access or query differences rather than absence of the event. The inherited Reddit discussion and tool survey do not establish current engine syntax, provider behaviour or lawful collection authority; no live queries, device searches or scanning are part of this lesson.
title: Search Engine Tradecraft: Google Dorking, Yandex, Bing, Shodan

raw: 10.2 Social Media OSINT: Scraping, Graph Analysis, Identity Verification
teaching_note: A matching handle or display name is an unresolved string match, not identity verification, account control or evidence of coordination. In a fixed synthetic packet, records R1 and R2 share handle 'museum_updates' but carry different supplied account IDs, A7 and A8; R3 republishes R1 with origin A7. Normalizing case yields one handle group but two distinct account records, and deduplicating by origin leaves R1/R3 as one lineage. The output is 'two account IDs share a label; ownership unknown'; treating R3 as independent support is the negative control, and removing account IDs requires downgrading even the record linkage rather than looking up a real person.
title: Social Media OSINT: Scraping, Graph Analysis, Identity Verification

teaching_note: A graph distinguishes entities, observed relations and hypothesized relations; proximity in a drawing has no evidential meaning. In a fictional static export, E1 says document D mentions project P and E2 says D mentions project Q, both derived from D version 1, paragraph 3, at the same capture time. The typed output is D→P 'mentions' and D→Q 'mentions'; the proposed P→Q 'same owner' edge is rejected because co-mention is not ownership evidence. Retain source/version/time on each edge and log extraction as the transformation; a tool-generated candidate edge does not authenticate identity, and copying D cannot strengthen the rejected relation.
title: Maltego: Graph-Based OSINT Investigation

teaching_note: Treat the framework here as a model of typed input, transformation and output, using a static export rather than executing reconnaissance modules. Record module/version, supplied input identifier, transformation and returned field so a reviewer can distinguish a source assertion from a tool-derived value. The inherited vendor overview and LinkedIn guide cannot establish current module behaviour; unavailable fields remain unknown, not fabricated defaults.
title: Recon-ng: Python-Based Reconnaissance Framework

teaching_note: Automation can multiply dependent findings and propagate one mistaken entity match across many output types. On a supplied event export, group records by upstream origin before counting corroboration and distinguish an event's observation time from the export time. A long results list is neither independent evidence nor permission for live collection; this lesson performs record analysis only.
title: SpiderFoot: Automated OSINT Collection

raw: 10.6 FOCA, TheHarvester, Sherlock: Targeted Investigation Tools[^54]
teaching_note: Document metadata, harvested strings and username-match candidates are different artifact classes with different error modes; none alone proves a person's identity, location or conduct. A metadata author field can be a template default, a harvested address can be stale, and a same-name account can belong to someone else. The Reddit preference thread is not a primary technical specification, so current capabilities and accuracy are unsupported here; use fictional pre-exported artifacts, not live tools or identity lookups.
title: FOCA, TheHarvester, Sherlock: Targeted Investigation Tools

teaching_note: A directory organizes possible resources; inclusion is not validation of a tool's accuracy, safety, independence or licence. Compare categories by the evidence they could produce, such as a document version versus a candidate relation, rather than by tool count. A missing or outdated entry changes the directory assessment, not the underlying factual claim.
title: OSINT Framework (osintframework.com): Module Taxonomy

raw: 10.8 Offline OSINT Environments: VM Architecture and Isolation
teaching_note: Offline means no external retrieval or interaction, not merely running inside a VM. Use supplied inert files with network access disabled, no shared credentials and an explicit manifest of inputs; record any text extraction or normalization without overwriting originals. A VM is not proof of containment, and an input that needs active content or a network connection is excluded rather than opened to complete the exercise.
title: Offline OSINT Environments: VM Architecture and Isolation
